instructions: Record of the AI configuration used for this exercise. Status values: used, not-used, default, redacted, not-exportable. Every saved_path is relative to the repository root. No credentials are stored anywhere in this record.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code 2.1.293 with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) for planning, building and review. Claude Code workflows (multi-agent orchestration scripts) were used for planning and for the first milestone; the rest was built in the main session with two subagents (a UI builder and a final verifier). Session settings were the tool defaults apart from the per-step effort levels set inside the workflow scripts.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: Connectors and plugins available in the session (Slack, Google Drive, Claude Docs, Chrome, Telegram, GitLab) were not used for this exercise. No IDE extension was used.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Google Gemini gemini-3.8-flash through the google-genai SDK 2.28.0, thinking level medium, timeout 60000 ms, 3 retry attempts; temperature, top_p and top_k not set (provider defaults). The grader's judge uses the same model and thinking level, set in reference/judge.py. Saved real responses: 16 application calls in runs/recordings/ and 7 judge verdicts in runs/judge/verdicts.json, recorded 2026-10-07 21:29-21:32 UTC (2026-10-08 local time).

skills.notes: Starter-pack skill, copied unchanged. Used as a checklist only when preparing the scenario inputs; no new documents were generated with it.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: CLAUDE.md is the project instruction file Claude Code reads. AGENTS.md points other AI tools to CLAUDE.md and had no effect because no other tool was used. The verifier subagent ran the final verification pass; the researcher subagent was not used. The two workflow scripts are saved as sanitized snapshots. Local private instructions and planning notes are not exportable; the user-level instruction file is omitted (see the README).

hooks_and_scripts.notes: One PreToolUse hook (Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Bash, Read). Exit code 2 blocks the tool call. It keeps starter-pack/ and data/seed/ read-only, allows edits to reference/ only when the human starts the session with QA_ALLOW_REFERENCE_EDIT=1, blocks reading or writing .env, and blocks staging or force-adding local-only files. First version in commit 9f7f30d, narrowed in commit 5e42644.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Two application prompts (draft, support check) and the grader's judge prompt. Every recording stores the prompt file path and its SHA-256, so a changed prompt cannot replay an old response. The four exercise rules in data/seed/domain.md are supplied input and are never edited.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Project settings hold the permissions and the hook registration. There is no project MCP configuration (.mcp.json) and no .claude/settings.local.json. MCP servers available at user or account level were not used (see plugins_and_extensions).

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Permissions: 7 allow entries and 2 deny entries, each explained in the README. Environment variable names: GOOGLE_API_KEY (record mode and judge only; the SDK also reads GEMINI_API_KEY), QA_MODE, QA_STATE_DIR, and the developer-only QA_ALLOW_REFERENCE_EDIT (set in the shell, read only by the hook, never in .env).
